candidate.answerReason: There are 26 yellow beans among 84 beans, giving approximately 30.95%, closest to 31%.

methods.label: Combine the actual bean counts
methods.explanation:
Because the bags contain different numbers of beans, first find the number of yellow beans in each bag. Those counts are
\[
0.50\cdot26=13,\qquad
0.25\cdot28=7,\qquad
0.20\cdot30=6.
\]
The bowl therefore contains \(13+7+6=26\) yellow beans out of \(26+28+30=84\) beans altogether.

The combined percentage is
\[
\frac{26}{84}\times100\%\approx30.95\%.
\]
This is closest to \(31\%\), choice A.
methods.levelReason: The solution uses familiar percentages to count beans, then calculates the combined part-to-whole percentage.
